I like the way things are organized. I like the calendar feature to separate the events from the tasks. I like that it’s not too simple. I like that you can see the tasks you’ve done already so it gives you a sense of accomplishment. Overall, it has all the features I want in a productivity app. It’s helped me a ton in high school and is helping me now in college. Big thanks to the team that made this app.

Only issue I have with it is that the time and date set can get buggy sometimes. For example, if I move a task up on the list, it can lose the time and date I already set for it.

title: Thumbs up for Any.do moment, which is absolutely ingenious
body:
I procrastinate A LOT, so the Any.do Moment really helps pressure me to finish my tasks. I'm a big fan of the minimalist aesthetic as well, because it helps me focus without causing the anxiety that comes with bold colors and busy text.

My only complaint is that it takes a long time to start up. Also, there should be an option/button/whatever to easily delete repeating tasks when they are no longer needed. Right now, I have to tap the task, tap the reminders button, remove the reminders, and swipe right to delete the reminder.
author: KN0W1T4LL

title: Ease and Simplicity
body:
I've tried other big name productivity apps (to-do lists) on the AppStore and it's Any.Do which really cuts it for me. Mainly in part due to its simplicity in classifying tasks according to 'Today', 'Tomorrow', Upcoming', and 'Someday', it helps keep you focused on successfully accomplishing the few most important things of the day - although at the expense of making big lists. 

My only concern is that the animation for drag-dropping (arranging) the tasks to other lists is kinda clunky as compared to a standard drag and drop with Apple's Reminders app (when using the Edit function).

title: Almost perfect!
body:
Very clean, minimalist, and a delight to use! Points of improvement though:

- An option could be created to make tasks whole-day instead of having to be assigned to a specific time all the time. Not all to-do's can be pinned to a certain time of day. 
- Although if tasks in a day are time-specific, maybe make them arranged chronologically in that day from top (earliest) to bottom (latest), unless they have been marked as a priority task. 
- A more interactive tutorial, or maybe a link to a video, could help make the learning curve less steep for first-time users!

I hope you consider these suggestions! Thank you for the wonderful app. :)

author: Chowqui

title: Has two issues, but great app
body:
Issue 1: the "notes" feature for each task is silly. Notes are often a sentence to a full paragraph, or even a list (grocery), so the current design of keeping the notes as one line is an issue. This needs to be more like a full text area.

Issue 2: there is no way to schedule tasks, so for daily tasks such as "exercise", i have to enter each task daily.

The two issues above are inconvenient enough to make me want to stop using the app, regardless of how wonderful everything else is. Please fix!
